lg.Account created. Check your email for th: Akaunti etunnukidwa. Laba e-mail yo mu nsiŋwa y'obuŋukusa.
lg.Add every branch you trade from. Each on: Yongera buli kizimbe ekikola mu. Kiragala kino kikwatagana ebizimbe bikkya, abakozi bakkya n'amateeka gakkya.
lg.Check it over. You can change any of it: Kebera bulungi. Walakata okukyusa kikomo kyonna nga okumala.
E-mail ekakyalire. Walakata okuyingila ka kino.
lg.Enter the 6-digit code from your email: Yingiza endoodde emyere ebiri k'omuweru okuva mu e-mail yo
lg.Pick the trade closest to yours. You can: Londa omulimu omuze nga gwo. Walakata okukyusa nga okumala.
lg.Put the workspace back the way the trade: Doola nsiŋwa ku nsoola omulimu gwaakateekateeka. Emusiness ebirala bijja tebitwalwa.
Slema ssacreens ez'otagenda okukozesa. Zaandikirira okuslema gwe mu usiness kino kennyini.
lg.Tell us who you are, what you trade in a: Tulodde wewe ani, gwe omulimu gwe, n'ekiro gwe ekikola mu. SMART_BUZ ejja kulungi nsiŋwa yo.
lg.The colour of your workspace. The trade': Ennansi y'ensiŋwa yo. Ennansi y'omulimu ejja kukozesa nga oteyetola.
lg.The screen that opens when you come to t: Ossacreen esuuluka nga oyingila mu usiness kino.
lg.The screens you chose were picked for th: Ossacreens owaali oyoola byali for omulimu omukadde. Londa eziwagala kino — ssacreens z'omulimu omumpya ndi ezaliwo.
lg.The trade you are in decides your VAT, y: Omulimu gwe gumaliriza VAT yo, ebiggwa byo n'osscreens zo.
Ssacreens si zi omulimu guno gumuuka. Slema ez'otagenda okukozesa — walakata okukyusa kiseera kyonna.
lg.This is how you sign in and how your sta: Kino kye kiro walinga n'ekiro abakozi baakusooka okukubira.
lg.Your workspace is back to the trade's ow: Nsiŋwa yo erudukidde ku nsiŋwa y'omulimu gwo.
